column2: Character: a veteran heavy knight in his forties, broad and powerful, short dark beard; a rounded great helm with the visor raised showing his face, a tall plume of cream off-white feathers on the crest; polished silver plate pauldrons, breastplate, gauntlets and greaves over mail; a plain cream off-white surcoat (tabard) to the knee over the breastplate and a cream off-white cloak lining; dark leather belt with a steel buckle; a broad arming sword in his right hand pointing down and a heater shield with a plain cream off-white face and a steel rim strapped on his left forearm.

The animal: a heavy medieval warhorse (destrier), powerful and deep-chested, bay-brown coat with dark mane and tail, feathered hooves; a polished steel chanfron on its face and a steel crinet on its neck; a full cloth caparison (barding) over its body to the knees, plain cream off-white with a thin gold trim at the hem; a dark leather saddle with a high back and steel stirrups; leather bridle and reins. No rider.
